added_lines: . we hope you can join us. the smg sisters served for many years in the parish of castledermot and sr. mary whelan from bolton hill is a member of the congregation. eucharistic adoration please note there will be no adoration this coming monday 26th october due to bank holiday. normal schedule resumes on monday 02nd november. thank you to all our adorers who have committed to their hour of adoration “the heart of prayer”. if anybody would like to commit to an hour of adoration, please leave your details in the parish office, thank you. ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, talks, and a healing service. speakers include: fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon pereira op , nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, chris tine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on www .firstsaturdays.ie . at fatima our lady promised that if we did what she asked there would be peace in the world and that many souls would be saved. weekly envelopes 2026/2027 the new year for the weekly envelopes begins in october and new boxes of envelopes are now available at the back of the church for collection. these contributions cover the running costs of the parish. we are very grateful f or the ongoing support provided by annual, half yearly, monthly or weekly contributions. standing order forms are available at the parish office. christmas choir invitation would you like to sing in castledermot’s choir christmas carol concert and throughout the christmas season? castledermot choir are inviting new and returning members to join the parish choir. no previous experience is necessary. if you enjoy singing, simply come along and be part of the music and celebration. choir practices will take place every wednesday at 8.00pm beginning on the 30th of september in the church. all are welcome! for more information, please contact the parish office or s peak to a member of the choir. castledermot local history group present “first heard over castledermot: the story of an american martin marauder that crashed near gorey in 1945” talk by michael rowley on thursday 12th november at 8pm in teach diarmada. all welcome. castledermot parish newsletter sunday 25th october 2026 levitstown kilkea castledermot

church notice board , bookshelf or table at the back of the church . please do not leave any material (notices, leaflets, books, publications, etc) on the table, bookshelf or on the church notice board without checking with fr damian or the parish office. phones: please switch off your phone when coming into god’s house, so as to respect the space of prayer and worship for everyone. our lady mother of the church castleknock in partnership with the parishes of st thomas the apostle , laurel lodge and st mochta’s porterstown . 25th october 2026 - 30th sunday in ordinary time solemnity of all saints – next sunday 1st november this is the great feast of those who have preceded us to our heavenly home. they accompany us on our earthly pilgrimage and encourage us forwards in the ways of faith, hope and love to join them. mass in our parish church for this solemnity will take place on saturday 31st october at 6pm and sunday 1st november, at 10am and 12 noon. all souls day, monday 2nd november our annual day of prayer for the souls of all the faithful departed. indulgences for the faithful departed: on all souls’ day, we can help the faithful departed by our prayers. a plenary indulgence, applicable to the holy souls, is granted to those who visit any parish church or public oratory on 2nd november and there recite the our father and the creed once. every day from 1st to 8th november inclusive, a plenary indulgence, again applicable to the holy souls, is granted to those who visit a cemetery and pray for the departed. it would be lovely if even you go there and simply pray: “eternal rest grant unto them o lord and let perpetual light shine upon them and may they rest in peace. may their souls and the souls of all the faithful departed, through the mercy of god rest in peace. amen.” world mission sunday on behalf of pope leo, thank you for supporting mission sunday in our parish last weekend -
